title: An Azomethine Derivative, 1-(4-nitrophenyl)-N-phenylmethanimine (BCS2) Ameliorated 7,12-dimethylbenz(a)anthracene-induced Mammary Carcinoma through Nrf2-Keap1-HO-1 Pathway.
authors: Acharya, Reetuparna; Deb, Pran Kishore; Pattanayak, Shakti Prasad
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子BCS2通过Nrf2-Keap1-HO-1通路抗乳腺癌，虽含分子对接与动力学模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIMS: The aim of this study is the evaluation of an Azomethine derivative, BCS2, for its antioxidant and anti-tumor activities against mammary carcinoma through the Nrf2- Keap1-HO-1 pathway. BACKGROUND: The global prevalence of breast cancer is rising at an alarming rate. The facilitation of abnormal cell proliferation in mammary carcinoma occurs due to the disruption of signaling pathways that balance pro- and antioxidant status, thereby producing oxidative stress that disrupts genomic stability. Therefore, introducing a potent antioxidant molecule with antitumor activity is of paramount importance for treating breast cancer. OBJECTIVE: Synthesis, characterization, and in vitro, in vivo, and in silico evaluation of an Azomethine derivative, BCS2, for its antioxidant and anti-tumor activities against chemical carcinogen- induced mammary carcinogenesis in Sprague-Dawley rats. METHODS: An azomethine derivative, 1-(4-nitrophenyl)-N-phenylmethanimine (BCS2), was synthesized and characterized based on its spectral data. The cytotoxic potential was observed on breast cancer cells, MCF-7, MDA-MB-231, and MDA-MB-468. The in vivo chemotherapeutic potential of BCS2 was established on 7,12-dimethylbenz(a)anthracene (DMBA) induced breast cancer in Sprague-Dawley (SD) rats. The effect of BCS2 on kelch-like ECH-associated protein-1 (Keap1), Nrf2, heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK), and nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated-B (NF-kappaB) was evaluated through ELISA and qPCR techniques. Furthermore, the binding potential and stability of BCS2 with Keap-1, HO-1, and MAPK were predicted using in silico molecular docking and dynamics studies. Additionally, drug-likeness properties of BCS2 were evaluated using in silico ADMET tools. RESULTS: BCS2 showed remarkable cytotoxic activity on MCF-7 cells followed by MDA-MB- 231 and MDA-MB-468 cells having an IC(50) of 2.368 muM, 4.843 muM and 6.472 muM respectively, without affecting normal breast cells, MCF-10A. In the DMBA-induced animal model, BCS2 showed potent antitumor potential and showed protective action on endogenous-enzymatic and non-enzymatic antioxidants in cancer-bearing animals. Marked improvement in cellular architecture and ultrastructure of breast/tumor tissues excised from experimental animals was noted through histopathological and field emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM) analyses. Significant upregulation of antioxidant proteins, Keap1 and HO-1, and downregulation of inflammatory proteins, MAPK, and NF-kappaB was observed after BCS2 treatment. The in silico computational studies predicted the potent binding of BCS2 with the active pockets of Keap1, HO-1, and MAPK proteins that validated the biological findings. CONCLUSION: The study revealed BCS2's potent antioxidant and antitumor potential against mammary carcinoma through the Nrf2-Keap1-HO-1 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在评估一种甲亚胺衍生物BCS2通过Nrf2-Keap1-HO-1通路对乳腺肿瘤的抗氧化和抗肿瘤活性。背景：全球乳腺癌的发病率正以惊人的速度上升。乳腺肿瘤中异常细胞增殖的促进是由于平衡促氧化和抗氧化状态的信号通路被破坏，从而产生氧化应激，破坏基因组稳定性。因此，引入一种具有抗肿瘤活性的强效抗氧化分子对于治疗乳腺癌至关重要。目标：合成、表征并体外、体内及计算机模拟评估甲亚胺衍生物BCS2对Sprague-Dawley大鼠化学致癌物诱导的乳腺肿瘤发生的抗氧化和抗肿瘤活性。方法：合成甲亚胺衍生物1-(4-硝基苯基)-N-苯基甲亚胺（BCS2），并基于其光谱数据进行表征。在乳腺癌细胞MCF-7、MDA-MB-231和MDA-MB-468上观察其细胞毒性潜力。在Sprague-Dawley（SD）大鼠中，通过7,12-二甲基苯并(a)蒽（DMBA）诱导的乳腺癌建立BCS2的体内化疗潜力。通过ELISA和qPCR技术评估BCS2对kelch样ECH相关蛋白-1（Keap1）、Nrf2、血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）和核因子kappa轻链增强子激活B细胞（NF-kappaB）的影响。此外，使用计算机模拟分子对接和动力学研究预测BCS2与Keap-1、HO-1和MAPK的结合潜力和稳定性。同时，使用计算机模拟ADMET工具评估BCS2的药物相似性特性。结果：BCS2对MCF-7细胞显示出显著的细胞毒性活性，其次是MDA-MB-231和MDA-MB-468细胞，其IC(50)分别为2.368微摩尔、4.843微摩尔和6.472微摩尔，且不影响正常乳腺细胞MCF-10A。在DMBA诱导的动物模型中，BCS2显示出强效的抗肿瘤潜力，并对荷瘤动物的内源性酶性和非酶性抗氧化剂表现出保护作用。通过组织病理学和场发射扫描电子显微镜（FESEM）分析，观察到实验动物乳腺/肿瘤组织中细胞结构和超微结构的显著改善。BCS2处理后，观察到抗氧化蛋白Keap1和HO-1的显著上调，以及炎症蛋白MAPK和NF-kappaB的下调。计算机模拟研究预测BCS2与Keap1、HO-1和MAPK蛋白活性口袋的强效结合，验证了生物学发现。结论：该研究揭示了BCS2通过Nrf2-Keap1-HO-1信号通路对乳腺肿瘤具有强效的抗氧化和抗肿瘤潜力。
